name: Motion Vector Analysis
description: Analyzes motion vector consistency and smoothness
algorithm: Motion Vector Analysis — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes motion vectors from video compression for forensic detection:

1. **동작벡터추출**: Block-level motion vectors are extracted from the video bitstream (H.264/H.265 encoded streams contain explicitly coded motion vectors). These describe how the encoder predicted each block from reference frames.

2. **동작Field일관성**: The motion vector field should be physically coherent — nearby blocks should have similar motion vectors (smoothly varying field) except at object boundaries. The method detects regions with anomalous motion vector patterns inconsistent with physical object motion or camera motion.

3. **Foreground-Background동작Separation**: Global camera motion produces a coherent motion vector field across the frame, while object motion creates local deviations. The method separates these components and verifies that face/body motion is physically consistent. Deepfake insertion may produce face motion that's inconsistent with the camera motion model.

4. **동작벡터크기분포**: The distribution of motion vector magnitudes follows predictable patterns depending on motion speed and search range. The method analyzes this distribution for anomalies — re-encoded deepfakes may show motion vector distributions affected by the original encoding, creating detectable double-estimation artifacts.

5. **PredictionError상관**: Motion vectors should produce effective predictions (low residual). The method analyzes the correlation between motion vector quality and prediction residuals. Regions where motion vectors are optimal for the original content but suboptimal for inserted content reveal manipulation through elevated prediction errors.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through motion vector analysis analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
